"'''''Loyal? Prove It'''''" was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] recruitment [[Painting/Legends|poster]]. As indicated by the name, it specifically sought out recruitments for the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]. It depicted two [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]], one [[Gender/Legends|female]], the other male, as well as a yellow and red background with the words "Loyal? Prove It!" at the top and the words on the bottom reading "Join COMPNOR Today!" with the smaller print below that giving the full name for COMPNOR, all written in the High Galactic alphabet. It was featured within the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' in the section giving a brief introduction to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], stating that within the Imperial hierarchy, loyalty of subjects must always be challenged, and that passivity must never be allowed.<ref name="IHB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Continuity===
Publisher [[becker&mayer!]] has confirmed that the Imperial Handbook is branded as Star Wars Legends despite [[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]] being produced after April 2014's split of the [[canon]]/[[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuities. However some referances to canon materials remain in this handbook such as the propaganda posters ''[[Strength & Obedience]]'', ''COMPNOR Recruitment'', and ''[[Expose, Pursue, Destroy]]'' (although the last one was slightly modified when it later appeared in canon).{{Imp-stub}}
